attachments.origin_landmark: greater and lesser horns of the hyoid and the stylohyoid ligament

actions: constricts the middle pharynx, propelling the bolus during swallowing

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Overlapped from below by the inferior constrictor and overlapping the superior -- the telescoped arrangement that produces the sequential stripping wave of pharyngeal swallowing.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
